words.example: I need your edits on the circular by EOD (End of Day) Thursday.
words.exampleZh: 传阅文件的修改我需要在周四 EOD（下班前）收到。

words.example: I need the signed roster back ASAP so the night team can plan.
words.exampleZh: 签好的排班表请尽快还我，夜班才好安排。

words.example: Please do not reply-all on a thread that names a patient.
words.exampleZh: 邮件串里有患者姓名时，请不要全部回复。

words.example: Forward the bureau reply to the liaison and to me.
words.exampleZh: 请把卫健委的回信转发给联络人和我。

words.example: Add your job title and extension number to the signature.
words.exampleZh: 请在签名档里加上职务和分机号。

words.example: The lab result for potassium posted to the wrong encounter.
words.exampleZh: 血钾的检验结果写到了另一次就诊记录上。

words.example: The critical result for hemoglobin has not been called to the ward yet.
words.exampleZh: 血红蛋白危急值到现在还没有电话通知病区。

words.example: This panic value for potassium needs a documented call to the doctor.
words.exampleZh: 这条血钾危急值结果需要留下已经通知医生的记录。

words.example: Result acknowledgement is still missing for the troponin called at dawn.
words.exampleZh: 黎明时报出的肌钙蛋白还没有结果确认。

words.example: Specimen tracking shows the tube left the ward but never reached the lab.
words.exampleZh: 标本追踪显示管子离开了病区，却没有到检验科。
